title: Cached Fib
statement: Implement `solve(n)`. Return Fibonacci n with F(0)=0 and F(1)=1, in linear time. Negative n returns `error`.
hints: Do not call the function twice per step.

approaches.name: Linear loop
approaches.explanation: lru_cache on the naive recursion also makes Fibonacci linear, with a cache entry per n.

editorial: lru_cache on the naive recursion also makes Fibonacci linear, with a cache entry per n. A loop uses constant memory. Both avoid the binary tree of calls. The negative check belongs before either approach.
